facts.shortSummary: The party surveys Circular Island from the mountaintop and considers investigating Apollyon’s tower.
facts.longSummary: After resting at the temple, the party watches sunrise over the island’s radiating rivers and pools. Apollyon’s black tower remains conspicuously intact to the west. They discuss visiting it and investigating the dragon’s territory, then return to reconnaissance that could have happened before the preceding night’s rest.

location.context: Temple of the Sibyl and the mountaintop overlook

facts.shortSummary: In a flashback to the previous evening, Seeker scouts the dragon’s lair with Clairvoyance.
facts.longSummary: Before the previous long rest, Seeker uses three Clairvoyance charges to inspect a ruined villa, a plaza, and thermal pools amid red-orange growth. Dragonets and four chimeras are visible. Kenzo cannot sense the dragon’s aura, prompting speculation about an extradimensional lair, but detects a fiend beneath the villa.

location.context: Temple of the Sibyl; remote views of the dragon’s territory

facts.shortSummary: The party takes leave of Dimitaur and chooses the tower as its first destination.
facts.longSummary: Back in the morning, Kenzo gives Dimitaur a statue of himself before the party leaves. They prioritize the tower and its possible forge over the dragon and jade. Kenzo senses no conscious creatures at the tower, although this cannot exclude constructs, mindless undead, or traps, and the party weighs travel options for the jagged coast.

npcs.name: Dimitaur
npcs.notes: Receives Kenzo’s farewell gift at the temple.

facts.shortSummary: Seeker prepares to transform the party into ordinary ospreys for the westward flight.
facts.longSummary: The party chooses inconspicuous ordinary ospreys rather than larger birds. Seeker’s Animal Shapes will carry them to the tower, with an expected flight of several hours. They plan to animate the rope ladder close to the destination so its shorter duration will not expire during the journey.

items.name: Rope ladder
items.notes: The party plans to animate it near the tower.

facts.shortSummary: The ospreys reach Apollyon’s tower with an animated ladder transformed into a fifth bird.
facts.longSummary: The party flies west past statues of the Warlord and Wildling. After a couple of hours, an oppressive presence pushes at them as they approach the tower. Seeker lands behind a boulder, animates the rope ladder, and transforms it into another osprey. They inspect the tower’s terrace, two stone guardians with metal fists, and a hatch at the top of the spire.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: The tower guardians shoot the approaching ospreys as the party reaches the rooftop hatch.
facts.longSummary: Crystal darts strike the birds just before they land, breaking several transformations and leaving Seeker hurt from the fall. The party gathers on the roof and investigates the handleless hatch with mundane inspection, Detect Magic, and Tremorsense. They prepare to use the chime under Silence, but the guardians move before that precaution can be completed.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

items.name: Chime of opening
items.notes: Prepared for the rooftop hatch.

facts.shortSummary: The party opens the hatch and escapes into the ritual chamber before the guardians can surround them.
facts.longSummary: A tiny mechanical fly has been observing the party as the guardians rise toward the roof. Wellby opens the hatch with the chime and jumps through, while Kenzo carries Seeker inside. Delwath follows after taking a dart hit and closes the hatch. Below it, they find an anvil, hanging manacles, channels leading to a well, and descending stairs.

facts.shortSummary: Seeker identifies the manacles as instruments for capturing sacrificed souls and creating a lich.
facts.longSummary: Putting blood on the anvil has no apparent effect. Seeker touches the necromantic manacles to identify them, resists their influence, and learns that they channel sacrificed souls into a nearby phylactery and help prepare a potion for lich transformation. The party considers using the mirror to discover Apollyon’s phylactery, but hears the guardians approaching from below.

npcs.name: Apollyon
npcs.notes: The chamber and ritual are linked to his transformation into a lich.

facts.shortSummary: The party holds the narrow stairs while the guardians advance into the ritual chamber.
facts.longSummary: Kenzo takes a flying position above the stairs, the animated ladder blocks the passage, and Wellby prepares to shoot from behind it. Delwath conjures shadowy lynxes, but their attacks gain no purchase on the guardians. Seeker retains concentration on Animal Shapes while the party works around the cramped approach and the constructs’ magical defenses.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: Wellby blinds the leading guardian while the ladder absorbs its counterattack.
facts.longSummary: Wellby shoots the first guardian’s eyes, giving Kenzo an opening for a flurry of attacks. The guardians batter the ladder and fire force darts, but cannot shove the oversized barricade aside. Delwath struggles to reach the enemy through the crowded stairway.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: A reflected spell forces the party to rely on arrows, strikes, and the ladder’s defense.
facts.longSummary: Delwath casts Sanctuary on the ladder, then discovers that an acid Sorcerer Burst rebounds from the guardian toward Kenzo, who deflects it harmlessly. Seeker becomes a large bird and inspires Kenzo while the ladder holds its position. Wellby blinds the guardian again so Kenzo can continue attacking.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: Kenzo is driven back as Delwath and Seeker press the attack at the stairway.
facts.longSummary: Kenzo deflects one punch but is knocked backward by another and wounded by darts. Delwath drops into the space between the guardians and strikes with a smite, leaving the leading construct badly damaged. Seeker attacks in bird form while the ladder continues to contest the passage.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: Kenzo and Delwath finish the two guardians, leaving only dust and mechanical remains.
facts.longSummary: Wellby shifts his blinding arrows to the second guardian as Kenzo destroys the first and flies around the survivor. Kenzo turns its punches back against it, Seeker attacks in bird form, and Delwath protects himself with Shield. Delwath’s final sword strike brings down the remaining guardian.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: After healing and salvaging the guardians, the party decides to question the mirror about the manacles.
facts.longSummary: The party heals Kenzo and the ladder, then retrieves two cracked metallic cores and two mechanical flies from the guardians’ remains. They weigh the mirror’s seven-day recharge against other questions they may need to ask. Since the manacles are fixed in place, they choose to investigate them now and hope to retain another use for Rai’s hand later.

items.name: Guardian cores and mechanical flies
items.notes: Two cracked cores and two mechanical flies are recovered.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: The mirror reveals that Apollyon’s phylactery is a plain adamantine dagger forged in the ritual chamber.
facts.longSummary: Kenzo asks the mirror to show the phylactery. The vision depicts a human Apollyon wearing a crown and rainbow cloak, forging an unadorned iron-hilted dagger with layers of inscribed adamantine. Repeated sacrifices send souls into the dagger, while collected blood and shadows from the crown contribute to his potion. Seeker searches for adamantine and gathers about half a pound of scraps, hoping they might help locate the dagger.

npcs.name: Apollyon
npcs.notes: Seen as a human in the mirror’s vision of his preparations for lichdom.

items.name: Apollyon's dagger phylactery
items.notes: Seen in the mirror’s historical vision; not recovered.

items.name: Adamantine scraps
items.notes: About half a pound gathered from the chamber.

facts.shortSummary: The party descends through the ruined upper floors and retrieves two surviving magical books.
facts.longSummary: An empty terrace, decayed study, and largely ruined library yield two intact books: an unmarked crimson volume and a locked book with a metal clasp. Seeker discovers that the crimson book is bound in human skin soaked in blood and explains how to become a lich. After handling it, he undergoes an unexplained saving throw; the party uses Mage Hand to place both books in the portable hole.

items.name: Crimson lich book
items.notes: A book bound in blood-soaked human skin containing instructions for becoming a lich.

facts.shortSummary: The party bypasses a room of moving metal and searches the tower’s living quarters.
facts.longSummary: They pass an Omnis Pura meeting room with imperial statues, then hear metal rattling beyond a partition. Delwath’s Ghostly Gaze reveals scraps swirling in the next room. Rather than enter it, the party flies outside as ospreys and reenters through lower windows. Searching three residential floors yields coins, a silver pitcher, a gold platter, and three plain gold rings.

location.context: Omnis Pura meeting room and residential floors

items.name: Residential valuables
items.notes: Coins, a silver pitcher, a gold platter, and three plain gold rings.

organizations.name: Omnis Pura
organizations.notes: Its meeting chamber and imperial statues remain in the tower.

facts.shortSummary: Wellby opens the audience chamber, awakens its skeletons, and seals the doors with an immovable rod.
facts.longSummary: At the entrance level, Seeker detects extensive rooms below and the party finds a stairway in a side guardroom. Wellby checks the audience chamber before they descend. Roughly forty skeletons, including one on the throne, begin to rise, so the party shuts the doors and braces them with an immovable rod.

items.name: Immovable rod
items.notes: Braces the audience chamber doors.

facts.shortSummary: The party destroys the trapped skeletons while a possessing shadow briefly forces Seeker to attack Delwath.
facts.longSummary: Seeker and Delwath fly outside as birds to attack through the windows. Once they resume their normal forms, the book’s curse makes Seeker strike Delwath with Catapult; a black shadow leaves Seeker’s face, and he remembers none of it. Delwath’s Sickening Radiance kills the skeletons over ten minutes. Seeker heals Delwath and Kenzo’s cleansing touch confirms that the influence has departed.

items.name: Crimson lich book
items.notes: A book bound in blood-soaked human skin containing instructions for becoming a lich.

facts.shortSummary: The party becomes elephants to push the jeweled throne into the portable hole.
facts.longSummary: With the skeletons destroyed, the party claims the large gemstone-studded stone throne. They rearrange the portable hole, moving its mirrors out of the way, and use Animal Shapes to become elephants capable of pushing the throne inside. They then repack the hole around their new prize.

items.name: Jeweled stone throne
items.notes: Loaded into the portable hole.

facts.shortSummary: A locked door below the storage rooms prompts a short rest before further exploration.
facts.longSummary: The basement contains spoiled wine and moldy silk, with another stairway descending to a locked metal door. Wellby finds no physical trap, while Detect Magic detects magic beyond the barrier. After roughly an hour of searching since the guardian fight, they return upstairs for a short rest with Delwath’s tea and biscuits; the ladder’s animation expires.

location.context: Basement storage, lower door, and audience chamber

items.name: Rope ladder
items.notes: Its first animation expires around the rest.

facts.shortSummary: After scouting the hidden forge, the party opens its door and triggers a fireball trap.
facts.longSummary: Delwath’s Ghostly Gaze reveals a pedestal with four openings and ten silver rings connected to a wall plate, a floating sword like a hole in the world, and two side rooms. See Invisibility exposes two large force hands. The party spreads out before Wellby unlocks the door and triggers a fireball; Wellby evades the blast, but Seeker takes 32 points of fire damage despite spending heroic inspiration.

items.name: Apollyon's forge
items.notes: Viewed through the door; its mechanism is not yet understood.

facts.shortSummary: The party rolls initiative against the void sword and force hands and plans to contain them with Sickening Radiance.
facts.longSummary: As initiative begins, Seeker reanimates the ladder instead of using a concentration-dependent summoned construct. Kenzo’s Soul Sight reveals the void sword’s formidable defenses, including immunity to psychic, necrotic, and poison damage and all conditions. The party plans to fill the forge with Sickening Radiance, shut the door, and withdraw.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: The void sword passes through the closed door while the force hands push after it.
facts.longSummary: Delwath fills the forge with Sickening Radiance and Kenzo shuts the door as they retreat. The sword slips through the barrier and stabs Wellby and the ladder. Radiance reveals one invisible hand. Seeker converts Psychic Disruption into fire with his glove to wound the sword, then withdraws as Wellby strains to keep the hands behind the door.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: The hands force the door open as Wellby critically wounds the sword and retreats.
facts.longSummary: A hand bursts through the doorway and knocks Wellby prone. He scrambles away, stands, and lands a critical arrow that badly damages the sword. The ladder keeps striking it, but the sword acts again, stabbing the ladder and Seeker while Kenzo prepares to use his tattoo’s reach.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: Delwath uses Scatter to rescue Seeker and places himself beside the sword for a critical smite.
facts.longSummary: Kenzo reaches the sword with Lengau’s Claw, avoiding psychic attacks that cannot harm it. After considering a wider teleport, Delwath uses Scatter to move himself and Seeker, taking Seeker out of immediate danger and entering melee. He withstands the sword’s retaliation and lands a critical Eldritch Smite.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

items.name: Lengau's Claw
items.notes: Lets Kenzo strike from beyond normal melee reach.

facts.shortSummary: The sword breaks into four void daggers, and Seeker sacrifices Animal Shapes to slow three of them.
facts.longSummary: Delwath’s blow shatters the sword into four independently attacking daggers. He uses Shield against their initial assault, though one wounds him. Seeker drops Animal Shapes and casts Slow on three daggers, ending the party’s easy flight home. The ladder grapples a force hand while Wellby destroys the unslowed dagger with a critical shot.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: The party destroys the remaining daggers and both force hands while the ladder holds the passage.
facts.longSummary: Kenzo and Delwath destroy two of the remaining daggers; the last evades Seeker’s Catapult before Kenzo finishes it. Wellby brings down the rear force hand with his fiery bow. The front hand shoves the ladder backward and knocks it prone, but Wellby destroys that hand as well, leaving the party free to enter the forge.

items.name: Animated rope ladder
items.notes: Seeker animates the ladder; it serves as a mobile barrier and combatant.

facts.shortSummary: The forge’s side rooms contain metal stock and a locked chest of magical supplies.
facts.longSummary: Using the last moments of Ghostly Gaze and Seeker’s Tremorsense, the party checks for more threats. One room holds roughly two hundred bars of silver, mithril, and unfamiliar metals, but no adamantine. Wellby unlocks a stone chest containing a damaged silver rod with organic spiral decoration and a star-like orb, twenty labeled boxes of magical powders, and rings.

items.name: Forge metal stock
items.notes: Roughly two hundred bars; no adamantine found.

items.name: Damaged silver rod
items.notes: Decorated with organic spirals supporting a star-like orb.

items.name: Magical powders
items.notes: Twenty labeled boxes recovered from the stone chest.

facts.shortSummary: The Tanshi confirm that the forge still works and draws its power from the user.
facts.longSummary: The chest’s three matching braided-gold rings bear emerald, ruby, and sapphire, while the other side room holds mundane etching chemicals. Kenzo senses no ley lines at the forge. In response to Delwath’s five questions, the Tanshi indicate that touching it is not known to be dangerous, it remains functional, the user powers it, instructions survive in the notes, and its price is complicated. The party leaves the mechanism untouched.

npcs.name: Tanshi
npcs.notes: Answer questions about the forge’s operation and source of power.

items.name: Three jeweled gold rings
items.notes: Matching braided bands set with emerald, ruby, and sapphire.

facts.shortSummary: The party finds a glyph protecting Apollyon’s locked spellbook and prepares to open it from a distance.
facts.longSummary: They take the rod, powders, and rings upstairs. The portable hole smells of blood from the crimson book, so they remove both books. Wellby spots a tiny protective glyph on the locked book’s clasp. Two attempts to dispel it fail, and they decide to use the chime from as far away as possible with the others around a corner.

items.name: Crimson lich book
items.notes: A book bound in blood-soaked human skin containing instructions for becoming a lich.

facts.shortSummary: After the book’s glyph wounds Wellby, Seeker deciphers Apollyon’s instructions for powering the forge.
facts.longSummary: The chime opens the book but triggers its glyph; Wellby suffers a powerful psychic blast while resisting its lasting mental effect. The volume contains backup spells and encrypted research notes, including forge instructions written in Elvish. Seeker spends three hours deciphering them, from about midafternoon to six, while companions rest. The forge consumes the user’s highest spell slot, recovered only after successful daily checks, and combines etched metal, powders, a hand plate, and an item opening. The rod appears to have been damaged in an attempt to destroy it, and the rings seem to have been found rather than made; their origins remain uncertain.

npcs.name: Apollyon
npcs.notes: His encrypted research includes instructions for operating the forge.

items.name: Apollyon's forge
items.notes: Its operation is explained in the decoded notes.

facts.shortSummary: At sunset the party returns to Dimitaur, who destroys the dangerous crimson book with fire.
facts.longSummary: Seeker encloses the lich book in a temporarily created lead box, and the party teleports back to the Sibyl’s temple at sunset. They ask Dimitaur to watch the dangerous book while they investigate the dragon the following day. Instead, he orders them clear, opens the box, and burns the book with a fireball. They report their tower discoveries and prepare to rest; no following morning occurs before the session ends.

location.context: Teleportation at sunset and discussion with Dimitaur

npcs.name: Dimitaur
npcs.notes: Destroys the lich book after the party returns.

items.name: Crimson lich book
items.notes: A book bound in blood-soaked human skin containing instructions for becoming a lich.

items.name: Lead box
items.notes: Created temporarily to contain the lich book during transport.
